                return [dx, dy]

        # Territory control style: prefer staying near center or map edge heuristics
        bbox = obs.get("map_bounds", {})

        # If at top-left quadrant, move right/down; otherwise random-ish but deterministic within bounds
        if w and h:

            y = 1 if (obs.get("pos_y", 0) or 0) < h // 2 else -1
            return [x, y]

        return [1, 0]
    if mode == "territory_control":

    return [0, 0]
